premises.text: Future of online commerce depends on knowing who you are doing business with in real time
premises.evidence_span: the future of online internet commerce is about knowing who you're doing business with

premises.text: Real-time identity verification uses social fingerprinting plus behavioral and transactional data to score authenticity
premises.evidence_span: We're a real-time online identity verification platform. We focus on using social fingerprinting, and we focus on letting you know who you're doing business with. Our platform uses social data as a primary. We add in behavioral data, transactional data. We give the merchant a score, and that score is all about authenticity

premises.text: During browsing, platform collects device, behavior, and order data; social sign-in augments with fingerprinting of profile and posts
premises.evidence_span: As a merchant or as a customer goes through the website, it collects data about the customer's device, their behavior, and the order they're doing. So when the customer checks out, they'd be asked to sign in with a social network

premises.text: Social graph signals mapped to real-world location are compared to IP, addresses, device fingerprint, behavior, and order history for a 0-100 trust score
premises.evidence_span: We compare all the socially graphed information back to the IP address, delivery address, the billing address, the device fingerprint, the behavior of the customer, and the order history. And combining all this information together, we can report back to the customer, or to the merchant, a score of zero to 100

premises.text: Verified social data pre-populates checkout to make transactions smoother and more secure
premises.evidence_span: we pre-populate the online checkout form with the customer's data, so their name, their address, and their email, making the online transaction smoother, easier, and a more secure experience for the customer

premises.text: Simple per-transaction pricing with no annual contracts or monthly minimums
premises.evidence_span: it's per transaction. You just pay for what you use. There's no annual contracts. There's no monthly minions

value.text: End online fraud by knowing the customer is who they say they are without destroying conversions
value.evidence_span: we're here to bring about an end to online fraud

secondary_value.evidence_span: making the online transaction smoother, easier, and a more secure experience for the customer

causal_links.evidence_span: knowing that the person that's buying from you is the person that they say they are
more secure experience for the customer
It's really like Stripe for fraud
